The title of the upper figure is “1958 Goldfish Phenotype Distribution”; the vertical axis represents the number of fish, and the horizontal axis goes from light pigment (Light pigment) on the left to dark pigment (Dark pigment) on the right. The 1958 curve reaches its highest point in the middle of the horizontal axis, the numbers at the two ends, namely the light-pigment end and the dark-pigment end, are smaller, and it gradually decreases from the middle toward the two ends. The lower figure is the distribution in 2008, but this question asks about 1958, so mainly read the upper figure. Then reason: The question stem states that the pigment levels of the goldfish range from pale white to dark brown; the middle of the horizontal axis corresponds to an intermediate pigment level, that is, medium orange; the left end corresponds to close to white, and the right end corresponds to close to brown. Because the 1958 curve is highest in the middle and lower at the two ends, the goldfish in 1958 were mainly medium orange, while there were also some individuals close to white and close to brown.
